battle.name: 哈斯蒙尼內戰
battle.theater: 耶路撒冷聖殿山與城郊
battle.brief: 公元前67年，哈斯蒙尼王朝兄弟希律卡二世與阿里斯托布洛斯二世爭奪王位與大祭司之位，兵鋒圍住耶路撒冷聖殿山，兩軍隔殿對峙近四年。公元前63年龐培率軍入聖地仲裁，王國自此淪為羅馬附庸。卡面秦連弩為東亞連發弩機，從未進入巴勒斯坦，此處借它說明守城者以連續射擊壓住攻城者的器械邏輯。

kit.name: 秦連弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，一踩一發。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 交戰的兩方同出哈斯蒙尼王朝，卻代表兩種不同的國家形態。以希律卡二世為首的一方，是王位、大祭司職與以土官僚系統合在一起的政權：公元前67年其母莎樂美·亞歷山德拉病逝後，希律卡同時握有王冠與聖殿的鑰匙，政務實際掌握在以土人安提拍特手中，軍隊則由希臘與敘利亞籍的僱傭步兵、僱傭騎兵、伊土里亞人的山地輕騎與阿拉伯人的游騎支撐；這支部隊沒有國家常備軍的骨架，靠的是首腦與僱主之間的契約。以阿里斯托布洛斯二世為首的一方則是聖殿派：他主張王位必須與大祭司職同歸哈斯蒙尼血脈，把聖殿區的祭司、樂師與宮中衛隊視為自己的柱石，圍城戰由將領托勒密·梅奈奧斯統率，外交上得外交家尼古拉·達馬斯克之助。第三方是羅馬共和國：敘利亞行省總督索西烏斯偏袒阿里斯托布洛斯，集結大軍與象兵入援，卻在龐培率師抵達後奉命退去；龐培以清理東方為名進軍，把兄弟之爭收編為自己的仲裁。此外還有第三種力量：伊土里亞、阿拉伯與以土各部族武力各自為利而介入內戰，隨勝敗而改換依附對象，使猶太王國的每一次勝負都同時改寫周邊勢力的版圖。
countriesEn: Both sides of the conflict came out of the same Hasmonean dynasty, yet they represented two different forms of state. The party of Hyrcanus II was a regime in which the crown, the office of high priest and the Idumean bureaucracy were welded together: after the death of his mother Salome Alexandra in 67 BC, Hyrcanus held the crown and the keys of the Temple at the same time, while day-to-day government was actually in the hands of Antipater, an Idumean; the army was carried by hired Greek and Syrian infantry and cavalry, by the light mountain horse of the Ituraeans and by Arab raiders, and it had no skeleton of a national standing army, resting instead on the contract between commander and employer. The party of Aristobulus II was the Temple party: he held that the crown had to belong together with the high priesthood to the blood of the Hasmoneans, and he treated the priests, the singers and the palace guard of the Temple precinct as his own pillars; the siege was commanded in the field by the general Ptolemy Mennaeus, and the cause was defended in argument by the diplomat and historian Nicolaus of Damascus. The third party was the Roman Republic: the governor of the province of Syria, Sosius, was inclined towards Aristobulus and marched up with a large army and elephants, yet he withdrew on orders once Pompey came within reach; Pompey, advancing in the name of settling the East, turned the quarrel between the brothers into an arbitration of his own. A third force also stood in the wings: Ituraean, Arab and Idumean tribal warriors entered the civil war for their own profit and changed their patrons as the balance shifted, so that every turn of the war in Judaea also rewrote the map of power around it.
people: 核心人物是哈斯蒙尼家的兩兄弟。希律卡二世自公元前76年起以大祭司身份治國，他性格謹慎、傾向裁撤王權，公元前67年一度打算解散王國、把城市交給羅馬人治理，此事洩漏後他反被弟弟的黨羽扣押，囚於聖殿北側的哈蒙尼亞王宮碉樓「巴里斯」之中，後來才在妻子與眾人求告下獲釋。弟弟阿里斯托布洛斯二世年輕而強硬，奪位後把聖殿當作堡壘，對外宣稱王位與祭司職一體，圍城期間由托勒密·梅奈奧斯在前線指揮。最能左右局勢的卻是安提拍特：以土出身的他從低階將官一路做到希律卡的首席幕僚，靠為哈斯蒙尼家族訓練以土輕騎與經營宮廷關係取得權力，聯盟的組建、派使往羅馬求援、以及希律卡本人的處置，都在他手上決定；此人的兒子正是未來的希律王。寫下這場戰爭的約瑟夫本人站在阿里斯托布洛斯一方，與外交家尼古拉·達馬斯克一同為其合法性辯護；希律卡方的兩名將領費薩利斯與伊提多魯斯叛投後反被自己人處死。局外最關鍵的人物是龐培：他帶著大量羅馬軍力進場，於公元前63年判定是非；同年隨後接管猶太的蓋比尼烏斯負責善後，凱撒則在執政官任期內（一般繫於公元前59年）放走了被囚於羅馬的阿里斯托布洛斯，約瑟夫另記這位王子此後曾集兵回國爭位而失敗，最終在埃及被托勒密處決。
peopleEn: The core figures are the two Hasmonean brothers. Hyrcanus II had ruled as high priest from 76 BC; cautious by temperament, he inclined towards abolishing the kingship, and in 67 BC he planned to dissolve the monarchy and hand the cities over to Roman rule. The plan leaked, and he was seized instead by his brother's party and shut up in the Baris, the Hasmonean palace-fortress on the north side of the Temple, and was released only later after the entreaties of his wife and of others. His younger brother Aristobulus II was young and hard, seized the throne, made the Temple his fortress, and claimed on the outside that crown and priesthood must be one; in the siege the operations at the front were directed by Ptolemy Mennaeus. The man who actually shaped the course of events, however, was Antipater. An Idumean who had risen from the ranks of junior officer to become the chief minister of Hyrcanus, he had bought his position by training Idumean light horse for the Hasmonean house and by managing the court, and it was in his hands that the coalition was assembled, the envoys to Rome were sent, and the fate of Hyrcanus was settled; the son of this man was the future King Herod. Josephus, the man who wrote this war down, stood on Aristobulus's side, and defended its legitimacy together with Nicolaus of Damascus; two generals of Hyrcanus, Phasaelis and Ithidorus, were executed after they defected. The decisive outside figure was Pompey, who entered with a large Roman force from Syria and beyond and passed judgement in 63 BC; Gabinius, who took over Judaea in the same year, handled the aftermath, and Caesar, during his term as consul (usually put in 59 BC), set Aristobulus free from captivity in Rome; Josephus records separately that the prince afterwards mustered forces to fight for his kingdom, failed, and was finally put to death by Ptolemy in Egypt.
kits: 卡面這件秦連弩是戰國末年東亞的連發弩機，弩機把拉力存起來，一踩一發，專為守城壓制逼近的攻城者而造；它從未進入巴勒斯坦，本場戰爭裡沒有任何一支軍隊裝備過它。但把它放進這張裝備表仍有道理：它的價值在於把連續射擊變成守方的主動權，而這個位置在本役正是由投石索手與弓箭手擔任的。哈斯蒙尼軍的編制沿襲馬卡比時代的分隊法，步兵中有一支專司遠射的分隊，投石索手與弓箭手合計近千人，與重裝盾兵、長槍手分開作戰；希臘化世界裡猶太人的投石索手因在馬卡比戰爭中的表現而有名，與希臘人、敘利亞人的攻城投射兵器同列。攻城方的羅馬軍隊則攜帶當時已定型的手持式扭力投石機與弩砲，配合土壘、塔架與撞槌；這些器械在幾年後希律圍攻馬薩德時被守軍的投石索手一一制住，正是卡面那句把攻城的人壓在牆外的實例。除投射兵器外，雙方的近戰裝備是鐵矛、長劍、銅盔與大圓盾；希律卡一方另有伊土里亞與阿拉伯的輕騎，馬槍兵與象兵（索西烏斯部）等重裝單位則只在敘利亞干涉期間出現。真正消耗最大的其實不是兵器，而是運輸、攻城塔、壕溝與營地工程的物資與工時。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the repeating crossbow of the late Warring States in East Asia: the mechanism stores the pull, and the machine looses one bolt per stroke, and it was made to let the defenders of a wall press the men who were assaulting it. It never reached Palestine, and no army in this war was ever equipped with it. Yet there is still a reason for putting it in this table of equipment: its value lies in turning repeated shooting into an initiative for the defenders, and in this campaign that place was held by the slingers and the archers. The Hasmonean army kept the divisional system of the Maccabean age, and among the infantry there was a division devoted to shooting at range, slingers and archers together numbering close to a thousand, fighting apart from the heavy shielded infantry and the pikemen; in the Hellenistic world the Jewish slingers were famous for what they had done in the Maccabean wars, and they stood in the same line as the siege artillery of the Greeks and the Syrians. The Roman army that came to besiege carried the hand-powered torsion stone-throwers and bolt-slingers already settled in that age, together with earthen mounds, towers and battering rams; a few years later, when Herod besieged Masada, those engines were defeated one by one by the defenders' slingers, which is the very thing the card's line describes: holding the assailants out beyond the wall. Apart from the artillery, the close-combat kit on both sides was iron spear, long sword, bronze helmet and large round shield; Hyrcanus had in addition the light horse of the Ituraeans and of the Arabs, while the heavier units, the lancers and the elephants of Sosius's army, appeared only during the Syrian intervention. What was really consumed in this siege was not so much the weapons as the materials and the labour of transport, siege towers, ditches and camp works.
tactics: 本役的戰術主軸是一場對峙近四年的封鎖與圍攻。開戰第一階段，兩軍在耶路撒冷以東通往耶利哥的山路一帶打過一場遭遇戰：希律卡一方的聯軍靠以土與阿拉伯輕騎的機動與投射掩護追擊，阿里斯托布洛斯一方的統將在奔馳中墜馬摔死，士氣受挫；阿里斯托布洛斯遂退守聖殿，希律卡大軍隨即以聖殿山為目標展開圍城。攻城方沒有選擇強攻聖殿的圍牆，而是把營地紮在聖殿對面的高地與坡地上，設壕溝、壘土與塔架，長期封鎖出城通道；守方把外院與柱廊一線當作前線，傷兵被安置在殿柱之間充作肉盾，弓手與投石索手據高處向下射擊，雙方在夜間反覆出營襲擾，聖殿的階台與門樓成了逐寸爭奪的目標。守方利用安息日不開戰的戒律取得喘息，攻方則趁這些間隙改進工事，形成攻方夜襲、守方依教法休整的僵持。海上，龐培先取沿海的約帕港，摧毀阿里斯托布洛斯一方的船隻，切斷其外援；陸上，敘利亞總督索西烏斯以大軍與象兵馳援，卻在羅馬軍營外被龐培的指揮權壓住。最後打破僵局的不是任何一方的攻城技術，而是羅馬的工程與仲裁：龐培在聖殿區築起土壘、架起塔架，攻城器械到位後僅以數日便取下聖殿，約瑟夫記為三日。
tacticsEn: The tactical axis of this campaign was a blockade and a siege that lasted close to four years. In the first phase the two armies met on the road east of Jerusalem towards Jericho: the coalition of Hyrcanus pressed the pursuit with the mobility and the covering fire of Idumean and Arab light horse, the commander of Aristobulus fell from his horse while riding and was killed, and the morale of the defenders suffered; Aristobulus then fell back into the Temple, and the great army of Hyrcanus at once opened the siege against the Temple mount. The besiegers chose not to storm the enclosure of the Temple but to pitch their camp on the heights and slopes opposite it, cutting ditches, raising earthen mounds and towers, and sealing the passages out of the city for the long haul; the defenders treated the outer court and the colonnades as a front line, posted the wounded among the columns of the court as a wall of bodies, and shot downhill from the height with bows and slings, while both sides repeatedly sallied out of the camp by night, and the steps and gateways of the Temple were contested inch by inch. The defenders gained respite from the rule that no battle is fought on the sabbath, and the besiegers used those intervals to improve their works, so that the standoff settled into night attacks by one side against rest by the other according to the law. At sea, Pompey first took the coastal port of Joppa, destroyed the ships of Aristobulus's side and cut off his outside support; on land, Sosius, the governor of Syria, came up with a great army and elephants, only to be held in check by Pompey's command outside the Roman camp. What finally broke the deadlock was not the assault technique of either side but Roman engineering and Roman arbitration: Pompey raised earthen works against the Temple quarter and set up towers, and once the siege engines were in place the Temple fell in a matter of days, which Josephus puts at three.
data: 關於數字，古代記載留下的有限，可以核對的只有幾組。圍城對峙的兵力，約瑟夫記為一萬上下，常引作一萬二千人對一萬一千人，數字接近而未必精確；其中雙方都把傷兵集中安置在聖殿的柱廊一帶，這一細節比總數更能說明守方的處境。龐培進軍巴勒斯坦的軍力，約瑟夫記為二萬步兵與六千騎兵；敘利亞總督索西烏斯率領的援軍規模遠大於此，並帶有象兵。時間上，內戰起於公元前67年莎樂美·亞歷山德拉去世之年，僵持到公元前63年龐培抵達，約四年；羅馬仲裁之後，阿里斯托布洛斯在埃及赫拉克勒翁被處決，內戰才算收束。地理上，耶路撒冷海拔約七百五十米，耶利哥在海平面以下約二百五十米，兩城之間約三十公里的下坡路落差逾一千米，這條路既是希律卡聯軍調兵的走廊，也是阿里斯托布洛斯一方向北取得援軍的通道。財物方面，約瑟夫記龐培取走聖殿財物約值二千塔蘭特。月份方面，史料只記年份而不記月日，本卡取一個有代表性的夏季值。
dataEn: As for numbers, ancient sources leave little that can be checked, and only a few groups of figures survive. The strength committed to the blockade is given by Josephus as of the order of ten thousand, conventionally cited as twelve thousand against eleven thousand, figures that are close but not necessarily exact; both sides concentrated their wounded in the colonnades of the Temple, and that detail says more about the condition of the defenders than the totals do. The force with which Pompey entered Palestine is given by Josephus as twenty thousand foot and six thousand horse; the relief army of Sosius, the governor of Syria, was far larger than that and included elephants. In time, the civil war began in 67 BC, the year of the death of Salome Alexandra, and stalemated until Pompey arrived in 63 BC, roughly four years; after the Roman arbitration Aristobulus was executed at Heracleum in Egypt, and only then was the war closed. Geographically, Jerusalem stands at about seven hundred and fifty metres above sea level and Jericho about two hundred and fifty metres below it, so the thirty kilometres between them fall by more than a thousand metres; that road was both the corridor along which the coalition of Hyrcanus shifted its troops and the route by which the party of Aristobulus reached help from the north. As for treasure, Josephus records that Pompey carried off the wealth of the Temple to the value of about two thousand talents. As for the month, the sources give the year but no day or month, and this card takes a representative summer value.
cause: 起因有四層。最深的一層是王朝的繼承規則從未寫定：亞歷山大·雅奈阿斯留下兩段婚姻的兩個兒子希律卡與阿里斯托布洛斯，兩人都以大祭司血脈自居，而王位與大祭司職究竟該合於一身還是分屬兩人，沒有任何成文辦法裁決。第二層是莎樂美·亞歷山德拉在位時刻意維持的權力平衡：她讓兩個兒子分掌大祭司與行政，形成一旦她去世就會失衡的結構；公元前67年她一死，平衡立刻崩潰。第三層是希律卡的政治取向：他打算裁撤王位、把城市交給羅馬人，此舉既觸動了阿里斯托布洛斯一黨的教法與血統底線，也讓以土人安提拍特失去存在的理由，於是消息走漏之後，他反被自己人軟禁。第四層是外部權力的到場：塞琉古帝國崩解後敘利亞落入羅馬行省，龐培剛在東方取得廣大委任權，任何一邊只要爭取到羅馬的青睞，就等於拿到決定性的外援；內戰因此從王族私鬥變成國際事件，也是雙方使節往來於羅馬與耶路撒冷之間、競相陳情與進獻的真正原因。
causeEn: The causes lie on four levels. The deepest is that the rules of succession in the dynasty were never written down: Alexander Jannaeus left two sons by two marriages, Hyrcanus and Aristobulus, both of them lay claim to the high-priestly blood, and no formal mechanism existed to decide whether the crown and the high priesthood should be united in one man or divided between two. The second level is the balance of power that Salome Alexandra deliberately maintained while she reigned: she had her two sons share the high priesthood and the administration, and the structure was bound to fail the moment she died; when she died in 67 BC the balance collapsed at once. The third level is the political direction of Hyrcanus: he meant to strike out the kingship and hand the cities to the Romans, and this step both cut at the legal and genealogical ground of the party of Aristobulus and deprived the Idumean Antipater of the very thing that made him necessary, so that once the plan leaked he was locked up by his own people. The fourth level is the arrival of outside power: after the Seleucid empire broke up, Syria passed into a Roman province and Pompey had just been given an enormous command in the East, so that whichever side won Roman favour held the decisive foreign support; the civil war thus turned from a private quarrel of the royal house into an international event, which is the real reason why embassies travelled between Rome and Jerusalem on both sides, arguing cases and pressing gifts.
impact: 最直接的後果，是哈斯蒙尼家族作為世俗君主的存在走到了盡頭。龐培的裁定把國家的權力一分為二：希律卡二世保留大祭司與民族長的頭銜，阿里斯托布洛斯二世被解除一切實權、押往羅馬；王國則淪為羅馬的附庸，軍隊被解散，領土被重新編排，龐培離開後，蓋比尼烏斯把猶太劃成五個區，由羅馬任命的監督與當地菁英共同徵稅，財源與人事都改了主人。第二層影響在宗教與制度：大祭司職從此長期留在哈斯蒙尼手中並逐漸寡頭化，聖殿同時是禮儀中心與政治堡壘，這種雙重性在希律興建第二聖殿時被放大，也成為公元前70年羅馬圍城時雙方死守同一座建築的心理根源。第三層是長期走向：阿里斯托布洛斯一家在埃及慘死之後，其子先後起兵復國皆告失敗；而長期依附羅馬的安提拍特之子希律於公元前37年奪取耶路撒冷，隨即處決希律卡二世，哈斯蒙尼血脈至此在政治上斷絕，猶太王國進入希律王朝，羅馬對巴勒斯坦的干預從此長期化、層級化，一個原本獨立的城邦王國被改造成羅馬東地中海秩序的前哨。
impactEn: The most direct consequence was the end of the Hasmonean house as a secular monarchy. Pompey's judgement split the authority of the state in two: Hyrcanus II kept the titles of high priest and ethnarch, while Aristobulus II was stripped of all real power and carried off to Rome; the kingdom became a client of Rome, its army was disbanded and its territory rearranged, and after Pompey's departure Gabinius divided Judaea into five districts where Roman-appointed supervisors and local notables collected the taxes together, so that both the revenues and the personnel changed hands. The second layer of impact lies in religion and institutions: the high priesthood stayed for a long time in Hasmonean hands and grew oligarchic, and the Temple was at once a ritual centre and a political fortress; that duality was enlarged when Herod built the second Temple, and it became the psychological reason why both sides fought to the death for the same building during the Roman siege of 70 BC. The third layer is the long run: after the family of Aristobulus was destroyed in Egypt, his sons raised revolts to restore the kingdom and all of them failed; meanwhile Herod, the son of the Antipater who had long attached himself to Rome, took Jerusalem in 37 BC and had Hyrcanus II executed soon after, and the Hasmonean blood was thereby extinguished as a political line, the Jewish kingdom passing into the Herodian dynasty. Roman intervention in Palestine became long-term and layered, and a formerly independent city-state kingdom was remade as an outpost of the Roman order in the eastern Mediterranean.
result: 結局是這場內戰既沒有在野戰上分出勝負，也沒有在聖殿下分出勝負，而是由第三方裁決收場。公元前67年至前63年，耶路撒冷聖殿山一直是僵持的中心：阿里斯托布洛斯二世守在殿內不肯認輸，希律卡二世靠聯軍與羅馬的干預在外圍維持封鎖。公元前63年龐培進入耶路撒冷，判定兩兄弟的爭端不該再由猶太人用血去解決，遂在聖殿內外進行仲裁：阿里斯托布洛斯二世被解除兵權、押往羅馬，希律卡二世以大祭司兼民族長的身份留任並接管國政，龐培同時進入聖殿內殿，一度令守方震驚。阿里斯托布洛斯二世在羅馬一度獲釋，得到凱撒支持後回國奪位，卻在戰敗後逃往埃及，於公元前62年前後死在赫拉克勒翁，家屬隨後被送回羅馬看管。哈斯蒙尼王朝的世俗王權就此告終，聖殿仍在，但守聖殿的人換了：公元前37年耶路撒冷落入希律之手，公元前35年希律卡二世被處決。對這場內戰的史學結論只能說：兵爭本身留下了城防布置、軍隊編制與圍城工程的痕跡，勝負則寫在兩兄弟的拘留史與一位羅馬將軍的仲裁裡。
resultEn: The outcome was that this civil war was settled neither in the field nor beneath the walls of the Temple, but by the judgement of a third party. From 67 BC to 63 BC the Temple mount at Jerusalem remained the centre of the stalemate: Aristobulus II held out inside the Temple and would not concede, while Hyrcanus II kept the blockade from outside by means of his coalition and of Roman intervention. When Pompey entered Jerusalem in 63 BC he decided that the quarrel between the brothers should no longer be settled in Jewish blood, and held his arbitration inside and around the Temple: Aristobulus II was disarmed and carried off to Rome, and Hyrcanus II stayed on as high priest and ethnarch and took over the government of the state, while Pompey himself entered the inner sanctuary of the Temple, to the shock of those who held it. Aristobulus II was released in Rome for a time, and after receiving the support of Caesar he came back to fight for his kingdom, was defeated, fled to Egypt and was killed at Heracleum in 62 BC, his family afterwards being sent back to Rome under guard. The secular kingship of the Hasmoneans thus came to an end; the Temple remained, but the men who held it changed: Jerusalem passed into the hands of Herod in 37 BC, and Hyrcanus II was executed soon afterwards. The historical conclusion about this civil war can only be stated in this way: the war itself has left behind the traces of the fortification, of the order of battle and of the siege works, while the result is written in the imprisonment of the two brothers and in the arbitration of one Roman general.
